value.rationale: Simultaneous left and right annihilators are canonical cancellation invariants for nonassociative unital algebras, crucial when two-sided inversion does not ensure cancellation. The complete line decomposition collapses an intersection of two cubic surfaces to at most nine rational lines; all characteristics and nonzero t are covered, the nine bound is sharp, and the finite-field character formula exposes a new structural arithmetic variation rather than recomputing known inverse/subalgebra counts.
